caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design centered around a large circle that is outlined in blue and filled with a pale beige color. Inside the circle, there is a stylized arrow-like shape pointing upward, also in pale beige and outlined in blue, forming the central motif. Flanking this central figure within the circle are four elongated, leaf-like shapes, two on each side, rendered in pale beige against a muted blue background. Below the circle, there are two mirrored, swirling lines extending downward and outward, also in blue, each terminating at a maroon-colored, leaf-like motif on both sides. Further down, another set of blue swirling lines bracket a smaller maroon motif at the bottom, directly beneath the main circle. The entire composition rests on a neutral, off-white background. There is printed text at the bottom indicating sources and project information, but no additional decorative elements outside the described design.
title: Wall Design - Asistencia of San Antonio de Pala From the Portfolio: "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
